reviewKind: Source qualification by reading the existing 41 candidates and their normalized records; not a rerun of screening, processing, tests or aircraft validation.
identityStatus: Source hashes copied from existing manifests; no new integrity-validation run performed. Derived artifacts identified by prior run directory, candidate index and source record/time bounds.
independenceRule: Do not split windows from either wholeFlightGroup across fitting and independent validation. Neither reviewed flight is an approved independent holdout.
uncertaintyRule: Source-level unknowns apply to every referenced candidate; no fit tolerances assigned.
redistributionStatus: Authored review metadata only; original raw exports and bulk numeric arrays remain local cache with reuse unresolved.

era22.sourceRecordMeaning: CSV record including metadata/header/unit/type rows; not a sample-array index
era22.cadence: approximately 1 second, two source gaps outside these candidate windows

units.requestedN1Pct: percent requested fan speed, not measured thrust
units.engineT2C: degrees C, total inlet temperature, not OAT

commonBlockers: surface inputs and brake force absent

uncertainty.note: Unknown; screening thresholds, published resolution and sample variation are not uncertainty bounds.

public-flight.sourceRecordMeaning: one-based row of joined dashboard timestamps, not a raw avionics CSV record
public-flight.cadence: approximately 6 seconds, processed chart points; two early source gaps outside these windows

units.oatC: degrees C per pinned OAT-only chart Temp (C) caption
units.fuelFlowGalPerHourRaw: gal/Hr per chart; US/Imperial convention unresolved

commonBlockers: normal-operation and complete automation/safety qualification incomplete
gallon convention and sensor/processing uncertainty unresolved
original raw export and downstream reuse not qualified
near-constant N1 provides no broad schedule identification
six-second processing excludes fast spool/damping/flare identification

uncertainty.note: Unknown; screening thresholds, published resolution and sample variation are not uncertainty bounds.
